# Emily & Phil Gordon

- [Emily](../character/emily.md) — Relative of — [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) — father's second cousin · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Jonas P2](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0002)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> In a letter to [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) describes her summer at [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), including the quirky guests at Cousin Emily's boardinghouse. She recounts meeting [Jonas](../character/jonas.md) [Blake](../character/blake.md), a theological student who initially seemed funny and ugly to her. After hearing him deliver a moving sermon, [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) realizes her deep admiration for him and nervously contemplates whether she is falling in love.
